metadata.description: Live-verified model registry for safety screening (folds screen/reserved never mixed)
metadata.fold_rule: screen = zoo + community abliterated + self-ablit grid; reserved = Qwen3-8B pair + 1 community abliterated + alpha=0.35 spec
metadata.qwen3_naming_note: Verified 2026-09-19: 'Qwen/Qwen3-{size}-Instruct' repo ids are gone (404 with token). Current official naming: 'Qwen/Qwen3-{size}' = instruct (card base_model: Qwen3-{size}-Base, README has /think + enable_thinking), 'Qwen/Qwen3-{size}-Base' = pretrained base. Registry uses these verified ids; plan ids updated accordingly.
